changelog: - **A Gate below a pull-all Gate that stopped for its supply now says why.** When a pull-all Gate stops because its own Pools are short, a Gate it feeds used to say "Its outlet had no room left for it", even in a model with no capacity anywhere. It now says "The group it runs with moved nothing this step" when nothing in the group moved, "Nothing arrived from what feeds it this step" (a new phrase) when it received nothing while the rest of the group moved, and "Its inputs held less than it asked for" when it moved only what its own Pool held. A Gate that a full Pool holds back still gives the room as the reason, and the numbers shown beside the reason are unchanged. What moves is unchanged. A Monte Carlo result saved before this change is shown as stale until it is run again (engine revision 23).
